paragraphs.en: JPMorgan and MUFG are part of the group that has spent more than six months trying to distribute $38 billion in construction debt tied to a Texas and Wisconsin data center project leased to Oracle.
paragraphs.zh: 摩根大通和三菱日联金融集团是试图分销 380 亿美元建设债务的财团成员之一，该债务与一个位于得克萨斯州和威斯康星州、租给甲骨文的数据中心项目相关，他们为此已花费了六个多月的时间。

paragraphs.en: JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley, SMBC and MUFG are quietly shopping pieces of the AI debt pile they helped build, a sign the lenders closest to the money have started hedging their own bet.
paragraphs.zh: 摩根大通、摩根士丹利、三井住友金融集团（SMBC）和三菱日联金融集团（MUFG）正在悄悄出售它们参与构建的部分 AI 债务，这表明离资金最近的贷款机构已开始对自身的押注进行对冲。

paragraphs.en: Six months ago, banks were racing each other to underwrite data center loans tied to Oracle, Meta and the rest of the AI buildout. Now some of the same banks are trying to get that debt off their books. JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley, SMBC and MUFG have been exploring significant risk transfers, according to a report from the Financial Times. These are deals that let a bank keep a loan on paper while shifting its riskiest slice to outside investors. The banks are doing this because they are bumping up against internal limits on how much AI-linked exposure any one lender can hold.
paragraphs.zh: 六个月前，各银行还在竞相承销与甲骨文、Meta 及其他人工智能建设相关的数据中心贷款。 如今，其中一些银行正试图将这些债务从自己的资产负债表上剥离。 据《金融时报》报道，摩根大通、摩根士丹利、三井住友金融集团和三菱日联金融集团一直在探索重大风险转移。 这类交易让银行在账面上保留贷款，同时将其风险最高的部分转移给外部投资者。 银行之所以这样做，是因为它们已经触及内部限制，即任何一家贷款机构能够持有的与人工智能相关的敞口上限。

sents.en: Six months ago, banks were racing each other to underwrite data center loans tied to Oracle, Meta and the rest of the AI buildout.
sents.zh: 六个月前，各银行还在竞相承销与甲骨文、Meta 及其他人工智能建设相关的数据中心贷款。

sents.en: Now some of the same banks are trying to get that debt off their books.
sents.zh: 如今，其中一些银行正试图将这些债务从自己的资产负债表上剥离。

sents.zh: 据《金融时报》报道，摩根大通、摩根士丹利、三井住友金融集团和三菱日联金融集团一直在探索重大风险转移。

sents.zh: 这类交易让银行在账面上保留贷款，同时将其风险最高的部分转移给外部投资者。

paragraphs.en: One case shows how stuck this has gotten. A group of banks including JPMorgan and MUFG has spent more than six months trying to distribute $38 billion in construction debt tied to a Texas and Wisconsin data center project leased to Oracle, Bloomberg has reported. Some lenders are now willing to sell pieces of it to non-bank buyers at a discount, just to move it. Six months is a long time to sit on debt nobody underwrote to hold forever.
paragraphs.zh: 一个案例显示出这件事已经陷入了多深的僵局。 据彭博社报道，包括摩根大通和三菱日联金融集团在内的多家银行，已花了六个多月的时间，试图分销一笔规模达380亿美元的建设期债务，该债务与一个出租给甲骨文的位于得克萨斯州和威斯康星州的数据中心项目相关。 一些贷款机构现在愿意以折扣价把其中的一部分出售给非银行买家，只为把它处理掉。 对于没人打算永远持有的债务来说，压在手里六个月是很长的时间。

sents.zh: 一个案例显示出这件事已经陷入了多深的僵局。

paragraphs.en: Matthew Moniot, co-head of credit risk sharing at Man Group, told the Financial Times the deal sizes involved are "out of scale to anything we've thought about, ever." That is not a hedge-fund manager talking down a trade he wants no part of. It is someone whose job is pricing exactly this kind of risk, saying the numbers no longer fit any model he has used before.
paragraphs.zh: 马修·莫尼奥特（Matthew Moniot）是景顺集团信贷风险共担业务的联席主管，他向《金融时报》表示，这些交易的规模“超出了我们曾经设想过的任何水平”。说这话的可不是一个想对某笔自己不愿参与的交易大泼冷水的对冲基金经理。 他的工作恰恰就是为这类风险定价，而他说这些数字已经不符合他以往使用过的任何模型了。

paragraphs.en: Oracle is the clearest tell. Its five-year credit default swaps, the cost of insuring against the company defaulting, climbed to around 151 basis points in early October, levels last seen in 2009, according to market data cited by Bloomberg. S&P had already cut Oracle's credit rating to BBB-, a single notch above junk, back in July. The company is reportedly targeting more than $40 billion in additional debt and equity this fiscal year. That is on top of the $18 billion in bonds it sold in a single day last September, and the money is needed to keep funding its Texas, Wisconsin and New Mexico sites.
paragraphs.zh: 甲骨文是最明显的信号。 据彭博社引用的市场数据显示，其五年期信用违约互换（即防范该公司违约的保险成本）在10月初攀升至约151个基点，达到2009年以来的最高水平。 早在7月，标普就已将甲骨文的信用评级下调至BBB-，仅比垃圾级高一个等级。 据报道，该公司本财年计划再筹集超过400亿美元的债务和股权资金。 这是在其去年9月单日发行180亿美元债券基础上的追加，而这笔资金对于持续支持其位于得克萨斯州、威斯康星州和新墨西哥州的站点是必需的。

sents.zh: 甲骨文是最明显的信号。

paragraphs.en: Oracle sued Wisconsin's Public Service Commission over a rule that could force it to post more than $7 billion in collateral for its Port Washington data center campus. The fight helped push S&P to cut Oracle's credit rating to BBB-, one notch above junk, as the company's AI spending outpaces its cash flow. - Oracle Wisconsin data center collateral dispute - utilities regulator $7 billion lawsuit
paragraphs.zh: 甲骨文起诉威斯康星州公共服务委员会，起因是一项可能迫使它为其华盛顿港数据中心园区提供超过70亿美元抵押品的规则。 这场争端助推标普将甲骨文的信用评级下调至BBB-，仅比垃圾级高一级，因为该公司在人工智能上的支出已超过其现金流。 - 甲骨文威斯康星数据中心抵押品纠纷 - 公用事业监管机构70亿美元诉讼

paragraphs.en: Demand for that paper has thinned out, too. Bonds from Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft and Oracle now trade at a premium to similarly rated non-AI corporate debt. Order books for their offerings have shrunk from roughly five times the amount on sale back in February to under two times by July, Bloomberg has reported. That is the difference between a bond that sells itself and one a bank has to work to place.
paragraphs.zh: 对那种债券的需求也已经萎缩了。 Alphabet、亚马逊、Meta、微软和甲骨文的债券目前的交易价格高于评级相近的非AI公司债。 据彭博社报道，这些公司发债的认购订单量已从2月份的约为发行规模的五倍缩减至7月份的不足两倍。 这就是一只不愁卖的债券与一只需要银行费力推销的债券之间的区别。

sents.en: Demand for that paper has thinned out, too.
sents.zh: 对那种债券的需求也已经萎缩了。

sents.en: Bonds from Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft and Oracle now trade at a premium to similarly rated non-AI corporate debt.
sents.zh: Alphabet、亚马逊、Meta、微软和甲骨文的债券目前的交易价格高于评级相近的非AI公司债。

sents.en: Order books for their offerings have shrunk from roughly five times the amount on sale back in February to under two times by July, Bloomberg has reported.
sents.zh: 据彭博社报道，这些公司发债的认购订单量已从2月份的约为发行规模的五倍缩减至7月份的不足两倍。

sents.en: That is the difference between a bond that sells itself and one a bank has to work to place.
sents.zh: 这就是一只不愁卖的债券与一只需要银行费力推销的债券之间的区别。

paragraphs.en: None of this is happening in isolation. The 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.304% this month, its highest since 2002, after a $39 billion auction cleared at 5.30%, the highest auction yield since 2000. The Federal Reserve's own September meeting minutes named AI-related corporate borrowing as a contributor to that move. Capital Economics argues the bigger driver is plain old inflation and government deficits, not tech company bond sales. Whoever is right about the cause, the effect is the same for anyone trying to finance a data center right now: the risk-free rate they are borrowing against just got a lot more expensive.
paragraphs.zh: 这一切并非孤立发生。 本月，10年期美国国债收益率触及5.304%，创下2002年以来的最高水平；此前一笔390亿美元的国债拍卖以5.30%的中标收益率完成，是2000年以来最高的拍卖收益率。 美联储自己的9月会议纪要也将与人工智能相关的企业借贷列为这一走势的推手之一。 凯投宏观则认为，更大的驱动因素其实是最平常不过的通胀和政府赤字，而非科技公司的债券发行。 无论原因孰是孰非，对于眼下正试图为数据中心融资的人来说，效果都是一样的：他们借贷所参照的无风险利率刚刚变得昂贵得多。

sents.en: None of this is happening in isolation.
sents.zh: 这一切并非孤立发生。

sents.en: The 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.304% this month, its highest since 2002, after a $39 billion auction cleared at 5.30%, the highest auction yield since 2000.

paragraphs.en: Frankly, the mechanics here matter more than the headline number. Banks do not sell down debt they are confident in. They sell down debt when they are worried about concentration, which is exactly what "approaching internal limits" means in plain English: too much of this bank's balance sheet is now one bet on one sector holding up. Spreading $120 billion of AI infrastructure spending across special purpose vehicles was supposed to make that risk easier to swallow. That is the structure Oracle, Meta, xAI and CoreWeave have all used to keep debt off their own balance sheets. Instead the risk is turning up at the banks that financed the SPVs in the first place.
paragraphs.zh: 坦率地说，这里的机制比表面上的数字更重要。 银行不会出售它们有信心的债务。 银行出售债务是因为担心风险集中，这正是“接近内部限额”用大白话说出的意思：这家银行的资产负债表上有太多部分变成了对单一行业能否撑住的下注。 将1200亿美元的人工智能基础设施支出分散到特殊目的载体中，本应让这种风险更容易被接受。 这正是甲骨文、Meta、xAI和CoreWeave都用过的结构，用来让债务不出现在自己的资产负债表上。 结果风险反而出现在最初为特殊目的载体提供融资的银行身上。

sents.en: Frankly, the mechanics here matter more than the headline number.
sents.zh: 坦率地说，这里的机制比表面上的数字更重要。

sents.zh: 银行不会出售它们有信心的债务。

sents.en: Spreading $120 billion of AI infrastructure spending across special purpose vehicles was supposed to make that risk easier to swallow.
sents.zh: 将1200亿美元的人工智能基础设施支出分散到特殊目的载体中，本应让这种风险更容易被接受。

paragraphs.en: The investors who still want in have gotten pickier about where. Capital is rotating toward data centers leased to investment-grade hyperscalers like Microsoft and Google, and away from weaker credits, Bloomberg has reported. That is exactly why CoreWeave-leased paper prices at 7.00% to 9.875%, against the 5.70% to 7.875% that hyperscaler-leased bonds command, per bond market data compiled by CCIR. A smaller, less capitalized AI infrastructure company trying to raise debt next quarter is now competing for the same nervous pool of lenders as Oracle. Except without Oracle's balance sheet or its existing customer base to point to.
paragraphs.zh: 仍想入场的投资者对投资地点变得更加挑剔了。 据彭博社报道，资本正在转向租给微软和谷歌等投资级超大规模云服务商的数据中心，而撤离信用较弱的借款方。 这正是为什么，根据 CCIR 汇编的债券市场数据，CoreWeave 租约的债券收益率为 7.00% 至 9.875%，而超大规模云服务商租约的债券收益率为 5.70% 至 7.875%。 一家规模较小、资本较少的 AI 基础设施公司若在下个季度举债，现在将不得不到与甲骨文相同的紧张信贷池中争夺资金。 只不过它既没有甲骨文的资产负债表，也没有现成的客户基础可以拿来说服人。

sents.en: The investors who still want in have gotten pickier about where.
sents.zh: 仍想入场的投资者对投资地点变得更加挑剔了。

sents.zh: 一家规模较小、资本较少的 AI 基础设施公司若在下个季度举债，现在将不得不到与甲骨文相同的紧张信贷池中争夺资金。

sents.en: Except without Oracle's balance sheet or its existing customer base to point to.
sents.zh: 只不过它既没有甲骨文的资产负债表，也没有现成的客户基础可以拿来说服人。

paragraphs.en: That's the part of this story that does not show up in a single day's stock move. The AI boom still runs on the assumption that credit stays open indefinitely at reasonable terms. Six months of a bank struggling to sell $38 billion in loans is the clearest evidence yet that assumption is being tested in real time, not in some theoretical downturn still years away.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是这个故事中不会在某一天的股价波动中显现出来的部分。 人工智能热潮仍然建立在信贷能够以合理条款无限期保持开放的假设之上。 一家银行花了六个月仍难以售出380亿美元贷款，这是迄今最清晰的证据，表明这一假设正在现实中受到检验，而不是在多年后才到来的某种理论性衰退中。
